config.ledit.title: LEDIt Configuration
config.ledit.wledAddress.tooltip: IP address or hostname of the WLED device
config.ledit.wledPort.tooltip: Network port of the WLED device (1-65535)
config.ledit.ledCount.tooltip: Number of LEDs connected to the WLED device
config.ledit.targetFPS.tooltip:
Updates per second (wall-clock based).
60 = synced to typical render FPS.  E1.31 handles any rate.
Animation advances per frame — higher FPS = smoother animation.
config.ledit.transitionTicks.tooltip:
Ticks for biome color transition (20 ticks = 1 second).
0 = instant change, 60 = smooth 3-second blend.
config.ledit.useE131.tooltip:
Use E1.31/sACN over UDP for lower latency and higher FPS.
When disabled, the JSON HTTP API is used instead.
config.ledit.e131Universe.tooltip: DMX universe number configured in WLED (1-63999)
